greenhelix-agent-loyalty-incentives 1.0.0 – Initial Release

- Provides a comprehensive guide for building machine-readable loyalty and incentive programs for AI shopping agents.
- Covers industry protocols (UCP, UIP, ACP, AP2), schema design, agent identity linking, real-time incentive negotiation, and anti-gaming strategies.
- Includes production-ready Python code for full API integration using the GreenHelix A2A Commerce Gateway.
- Designed to help merchants make loyalty programs discoverable, evaluable, and redeemable by AI agents.
